result.summary: test/support/fake_invocation_connection_test.exs: 5 tests, Letflow.DataCase async false, Repo switched to :auto in setup (sandbox transaction caches pg_stat_activity snapshot, as sibling reaper tests handle). Run twice: 5 passed each. format, compile --warnings-as-errors, lint_handoffs clean. start! timeout is made deterministic with a tag longer than 63 bytes (Postgres truncates application_name, so equality never matches); no helper change. Mutants (each reverted, verified): M1 stop_and_wait_gone! skips the poll -> 1/5 failed (timeout test); M2 opts drops the real tag -> 4/5 failed; M3 start! poll never gives up -> 1/5 failed. Caveat: 'returns :ok only after tag gone' cannot deterministically kill M1 because the backend leaves quickly; the late-leave race itself is not reproducible without a seam. Optional on_exit leak test skipped.
